usage: 水蛋 (seoi2 daan6) is a noun that refers to a type of steamed egg custard dish commonly served in Cantonese restaurants.
You can use 水蛋 as the subject, object, or part of a sentence when ordering or talking about food.
It usually appears in menus and conversations related to Hong Kong style cafes (cha chaan teng).
When describing the dish, you can mention its texture or taste together with 水蛋.
It can be combined with other words to talk about variations, like adding toppings or sauces.
